description: Check a change to a database or its keys and return a one-time confirmation for exactly that change, valid for five minutes; helix_execute_admin_operation runs it. Preparing changes nothing.

operation.description: create_tenant makes a database in a project, delete_tenant deletes one, and create_database_key and revoke_database_key manage a database's gateway keys.

payload.description: Operation payload object. create_tenant: {project_id (equal to the target project id), name, slug, optional cluster_id, optional plan_code}. delete_tenant: {}. create_database_key: {name, access (read_only or read_write)}. revoke_database_key: {key_id}.

target.description: create_tenant: project:<id>. delete_tenant: tenant:<id>. The key operations: the database, cluster:<id> or tenant:<id>.

name: helix_prepare_admin_operation
title: Prepare a database or key change
